sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. This I.A. has been filed by the Petitioner seeking interim release, on account of health condition of his wife, in connection with S.T. Case No.87/3 of 2022-23 pending on the file of learned District and Sessions Judge, Nuapada, arising out of Komna P.S. Case No.136 of 2022 for commission of offence alleged under Sections 376/ 302/ 201/ 120(B) of the IPC.
3.
It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioner is in custody since 11.06.2022.

4. Referring to the medical documents on record, it is submitted by the learned counsel for the Petitioner that surgical intervention is necessary and because of lack of Anaesthesia facilities in the D.H.H., Nuapada, Petitioner's wife has been referred to another centre, for which presence of the Petitioner is essential.
In this context, she refers to the Referral Certificate at Annexure-4.
5. Learned counsel for the State submits that there are other members in the family who can take care of the Petitioner's wife.
Hence, the prayer for interim bail ought not to be considered.
6. Without entering into the contours of merits, this Court on humanitarian grounds directs the Petitioner to be released on interim bail for a period of two (2) months from the date of his release.
Terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.

sentences.text: Additionally, it is directed that during the currency of interim bail, the Petitioner shall not indulge himself in any other offence and shall appear before the jurisdictional police station once a fortnight on such date and time to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.
Certification of such appearance shall be submitted to the Court in seisin.
8. It is further directed that that during the currency of interim bail period, the Petitioner shall appear before the learned Trial Court on the date fixed for trial without fail.

If there is any default on the said count, it shall be open for the learned Trial Court to take steps in accordance with law to remand the Petitioner to custody without any further reference to this Court.
9. It is needless to state that on expiry of the interim bail period, the Petitioner shall surrender.
10. Accordingly, I.A. stands disposed of.
11. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per the rules.
